name: notes
description: The notes plugin: a local Markdown knowledge base wired into Claude Code, with automatic recall on every prompt and one skill per note kind: fact, idea, decision, and reminder.

plugins.name: notes
plugins.description: Surfaces unread reminders and relevant notes from your ~/.notes vault on every prompt, and adds one skill per note kind - fact, idea, decision, reminder - that drafts a note for you to confirm before it is saved. Requires the `notes` CLI from this repository and an initialized vault.
